description: Open-source toolbox expanded for multi-animal pose estimation, including multi-task CNNs for keypoint localization, animal assembly, tracking, and GUI support for annotation and trajectory verification.

A multi-scale deep learning architecture for multi-animal pose estimation that predicts keypoint locations, part affinity fields, and animal re-identification outputs to support individual assembly in scenes with multiple animals.
A deep learning toolbox for animal pose estimation and tracking, including pose estimation, identity prediction, and tracking of individuals across video frames.

A multi-animal pose estimation and tracking system that extends DeepLabCut with multi-animal tracking, identity-aware tracking, and flexible bottom-up and top-down pipelines for animal behavior analysis.
A graphical and code-light toolbox for animal pose estimation and tracking from video, supporting markerless analysis and keypoint labeling workflows.
A deep-learning toolbox and model framework for animal pose estimation, keypoint tracking, and part association using score maps, location refinement, and part affinity fields.

Paper describing DeepLabCut methods for multi-animal pose estimation, including crop sampling strategies, CNN-based identity prediction, and data-driven part affinity graph selection for animal assembly.

A paper describing a graph-based animal assembly method for multi-animal pose estimation, including calibrated linkage using pose priors, optional temporal coherence for videos, top-down pose estimation, and evaluation with keypoint and assembly metrics.
OpenMMLab toolbox for 2D pose estimation used here for bottom-up animal pose models with associative embedding (HRNet-AE and ResNet-AE) in benchmarking against DeepLabCut.

Method for reconstructing full trajectories from sparse tracklets in animal tracking using a network flow formulation and affinity models including motion affinity, spatial proximity, shape similarity, and dynamic similarity.

A tracking workflow described in the DeepLabCut context that stitches tracklets using min-cost flow, then applies a transformer-based metric learning approach to identify animals from keypoint embeddings and improve tracking performance.
